scope: one spirit wolf lifecycle plus one logout/relog-from-disk recovery boundary; not a quest/matrix campaign

results.name: Infuse, summon and dismiss a spirit wolf consume the native materials, points and pouch()
A spirit wolf saved to disk is restored once after relog with the pouch and points unchanged()
The real summoning level still gates the pouch()
Drained summoning points don't block summoning a familiar()

fixtures.owner: new player at Tile(2523, 3056), real Summoning level 1 (default experience), full points pool
fixtures.materials: charm, shard, blank pouch and tertiary added straight into the inventory, amounts read from spirit_wolf_pouch definitions
fixtures.obelisk: GameObjects.find(Tile(2521, 3055), 'obelisk') with Infuse-pouch then interface Infuse
fixtures.save: native SaveQueue(FileStorage).direct() into the isolated saves folder, read back with PlayerSave.load
fixtures.relog: PlayerSave.toPlayer() into a new Player, then AccountManager.setup/index/spawn and 3 ticks

recovery_boundary.reconstructed: the familiar NPC is not persisted; playerSpawn rebuilds it from the saved familiar_details timer
recovery_boundary.owner_count_check: NPCs filtered by id spirit_wolf_familiar and owner_index == player.index

fixture_limits: Not a 154-recipe or familiar-wide run; one spirit wolf pouch only
Materials are supplied by fixture, not earned through Pikkupstix, shops, drops or travel
No real profile or save: the test writes to the isolated test saves folder
The relog is a same-process reload into a fresh Player, not a server restart
Scroll/howl special and Wolf Whistle are not exercised
Expiry while online is not exercised; only the logout recovery boundary

iterations.cause: test timing: NPC removal from logout is queued until the next tick
in-memory relog version, superseded by disk round trip
rewritten to native disk save and fresh Player reload, beginner level

gaps: Earned route: charm, shard and tertiary acquisition are not proven from native sources in this pass
Howl scroll and Wolf Whistle are not exercised
Expiry while online and owner death are not covered by this test
isolation_guard: Suite requires SOLOSCAPE_TEST_ROOT; skipped when absent to protect default mutable paths.

coordinator_review.reproducer: Run the two selected classes with explicit JDK21 and SOLOSCAPE_TEST_ROOT; see report.
